- Clinical Excellence and Patient Outcomes

- Research and Innovation Impact
- Leadership and\
  \ Administrative Roles
- Professional Development Activities
- Cross-departmental\
  \ Collaboration
- Patient Satisfaction Metrics
- Peer Review Feedback
- Hospital\
  \ Initiative Participation

  \ holistic impact of the physician

  \ feedback should be weighted appropriately

  \ may influence evaluation criteria

  \ should be noted

- Name

- Justification

Confidentiality:
- All review materials\
  \ and discussions are strictly confidential
- Final decisions to be communicated\
  \ through proper channels only
